title: works well, easy to clean
text:
works well, easy to clean. howdy y'all,

this baking pan works well and is easy to clean. it's a tad odd that it's marked only with "betterbake" and not a sign of "chicago metallic", but that is nothing to worry about. [*grin*]

the pan is smooth all around. that is significant since several such pans i have looked at are folded, not forged or pressed. the folds on those other pans can sometimes be a bother to clean. no such problem with this one.

the edges are rolled and there is a small but grip-able lip on two opposing sides. it's easy to pick up ... unlike one pan i have that has rolled edges but no place to grip the darned thing.

i've made corn bread in my countertop oven in this several times and used it to roast a pork loin in - plus other things. easy to clean in all cases.

rated a THREE since it is as expected - no more, no less.

take care,
lee
